name: banishing_light_exiled_permanent_returns_when_it_leaves
notes: P951d09dde7 G4. Printed: 'When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.' Seat 0 casts Banishing Light ({2}{W}); its trigger targets seat 1's 2/2, which is exiled. Then Banishing Light is destroyed (moved to its owner's graveyard): the 2/2 returns to the battlefield under its owner's (seat 1's) control (CR 610.3). Seat 1's other permanent is never touched.
